name: hawkbell AI agent sensor (in-image hook mode)
description: SKETCH, UNTESTED with the devcontainer CLI: installs the hawkbell binary (SHA-256 verified), registers managed hooks for the AI agents in the image and starts the hawkbell daemon at container start so its records reach the container log. See deploy/kubernetes/README.md.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of hawkbell_linux_<arch> from the release's checksums.txt (required)

url.description: Base URL of the release downloads

agents.description: Agents to register managed hooks for (catalog ids)
